comparison.objective: Drive two opposed tapered shims behind a door jamb until snug without bowing it; candidate removes a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests opposed bimanual insertion, taper alignment, and balanced force control. Candidate tests dual-blade access around a contact, two-tang release, and coordinated wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires correctly oriented overlapping shims, a snug gap, bounded jamb deflection, release, and 2 s rest. Candidate requires selective rear extraction, intact housing/crimp, retained neighbors, and 3 s rest.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual force control is generic; balanced tapered wedging does not test internal latch release or contact extraction.
